## 0.6.4 — 2026-11-18
- The "update is ready" notice now says what's new. It lists the changes from every version newer than the one you're running, so if you skipped a release you still see what you missed.

## 0.6.3 — 2026-11-18
- Browse has a Steering tab. Every `~` line from every note in one place: due ones first, who it's from, daily or weekly, how many of the last 14 days you answered, and the notes it appears in. Tap a day, or Yes / Partly / No for today, to check in.
- Pin the notes you're actively working on. A Pin button next to Copy notes puts a note in a Pinned section at the top of the left rail, newest pin first; Unpin sends it back to its day. Pins sync to your other devices, and on the iPhone pinned notes lead the Notes list and the capture destinations.

## 0.6.2 — 2026-11-18
- Nested tasks, questions, ideas and the rest. Indent a marked line (2 spaces or a tab) under another and it stays part of that line's thread in your text. Press Tab to indent the line or selected lines, Shift-Tab to bring them back. Only top-level lines go to the right rail, so a sub-task or follow-up question doesn't crowd it; nested lines still show in the editor with their colors and can be checked off with ⌘Enter.

## 0.6.1 — 2026-11-18
- Sync no longer pulls focus out of the note while you type. A sync that brings in changes used to rebuild the whole page, which dropped the cursor from the text box; now it updates the list and any changed text in place and leaves your caret where it was.

## 0.6.0 — 2026-11-17
- Sync, off until you turn it on. The new line at the bottom of the left rail opens a Sync panel where you sign in to Suite Sync with Google or Apple, the same server Tasks, Notes and Compass use. Nothing leaves your Mac until you type `upload` to confirm; after that your notes, review flags and steering check-ins stay in step across every device you sign in on. Your notes still live on this computer too.
- An iPhone app (cable install for now) built for rapid capture: type an idea, tap a marker (`[]` `![]` `!?` `?` `*` `~`), add a `#tag` or `@person`, pick a note or the Inbox, Save. A Triage tab sorts what's waiting, and a Notes tab lets you search and read every note. The phone never edits note text itself: this Mac files each capture into its note the next time it syncs, so two devices can't overwrite each other.

## 0.5.3 — 2026-11-17
- Removed the banner above your notes that counted notes to review, late commitments and open decisions. The Review button in the left rail does the nudging instead: it looks normal during the day, and from 4pm it fills with the accent color and shows how many notes are left. Nothing is red.

## 0.5.2 — 2026-11-17
- A `[[Group]]` now ends at the first blank line after its lines, so a header over one line brings over only that line, for links and for moves (`[[Name]]>>`). Blank lines right after the header are skipped. Before, a single blank line didn't end it and the next paragraph came along. Autocomplete and `⌘⇧G` work on a single line.
- Line height is now a whole 24px and inline spans no longer stretch the highlight line, so the caret and the highlight stay aligned with the text on every line, including the first.

## 0.5.1 — 2026-11-17
- Fixed the real cause of the cut-off bottom and the highlight sitting off the text on some notes. The text box was only measured when you typed or opened a note, so anything that changed its width afterwards (resizing the window or the left rail, a scrollbar appearing, fonts loading) left it too short. It then scrolled inside itself, hiding the last lines and shifting the text against the highlight. It now re-measures whenever its width changes and never scrolls inside itself.
- Tagged lines no longer get a colored background wash. They keep the thin colored bar at the left edge.
